bpmn:collaboration.name: A run, from the runner's side
bpmn:collaboration.bpmn:documentation: A local run, from a partial runner's side. The walk starts every runner and asks for its claims before the first step, and a runner that refuses stops the run. It then hands each claimed element to its runner with the run's values, adopts what the runner hands back, and commits the run directory. The runner speaks the walk's contract on one side and its tool's own protocol on the other. Drawn for docs/developers.qmd.

bpmn:task.name: Ask every runner for its claims

bpmn:endEvent.name: The run stops before any step

bpmn:task.name: Hand over the next claimed element
Adopt what it binds, commit the run directory
Answer with the ids it takes
Read the plan and the values
Run the element with the tool

g.text: The run stops before any step
